scope: Release scientific copy and code-rendering review within Round3; no new research or hardware validation. Root owns browser functional/visual inspection.

findings.location: src/app.mjs sweep result efficiency and optimum text
findings.problem: Fixed-drive zero-voltage and zero-force sweeps return a best cell with inputW=0 and efficiency=null; b.efficiency*100 coerces null to zero and renders 0%. The output also calls this an optimum.
findings.requestedChange: Preserve undefined efficiency for null values and state no positive-input transfer at this drive, rather than describing an efficiency or meaningful conversion optimum.

findings.problem: The phrase equal measured input power mislabels the model comparison as measured. The site has no hardware measurements.
HTML allows .001–1000 but identifiabilityDemo accepts .01–100, causing avoidable input rejection.
Independent uncertainty is ambiguous wording where covariance and correlated channels matter.
findings.requestedChange: Prefer covariance-aware uncertainty and independent diagnostic checks.

accepted: J versus W are kept separate; phase example explicitly retains VA and RMS assumptions.
Signed ledger and chosen expanded interval match API; user-supplied standard uncertainty, k-factor limitation and no double-counted heat are stated.
Zero uncertainty inherits the API caution rather than being presented as exact measurement.
Main conversion readout already preserves null efficiency as Undefined.
EM terminal and acoustic receiver efficiencies exclude their named upstream supplies; acoustic nested boundaries avoid double counting.
Quantum GHz-to-Hz conversion, prepared-state meaning, damping/dephasing definitions and ideal ergotropy boundary are correct.
Independent formulations and selected synthetic diagnostics are distinguished from human peer review and physical replication; panel explicitly says three cards are not a reliability benchmark.
Schematics are conceptual/topology drawings with no measured traces or physical dimensions asserted.
notAssessed: Browser layout/interaction/accessible focus paths; root owns that verification.
Accuracy of every external evidence record; this review covers the supplied page templates, calculator-rendering copy, panel summary and SVG text.
